messages.subject: Executive Candidate Introduction | New Zealand Leadership Opportunities
messages.body:
Dear Aurora Careers Team,

I am contacting you through your current official address following a failed delivery to an earlier route. I serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with more than 12 years across multinational mining, financial services, government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, stakeholder management and executive operations.

I am internationally mobile and interested in New Zealand opportunities across sustainability, external and corporate affairs, government relations, strategic partnerships, business development, country operations and senior management.

My executive CV is attached for review. I would welcome consideration for suitable opportunities and guidance on roles where employer sponsorship or relocation support is available.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
